write_up: Your resume tells a strong store management story at Carolina Home & Garden, from department supervision to running a $9.4M store. A recruiter can see your team and results quickly, though the headline claims two turnarounds and the roles don't yet show both.

The turnover line is a great model: it shows the change and the scheduling decision behind it. Your sales and shrink lines do similar work, so a recruiter has concrete reasons to move you forward with a question about that headline.
Let's start with the two-store claim. Add what changed at each store if you can, or narrow the headline to the turnaround your experience already shows.
